svg.title: Left, right, midpoint and trapezoidal sums compared
svg.desc: Four panels show the graph of f(x) = 0.25x squared + 1 on [0, 4], increasing and concave up, with four subintervals of width 1. Left sum: rectangles with heights f(0), f(1), f(2), f(3), total 7.5, an underestimate. Right sum: heights f(1) to f(4), total 11.5, an overestimate. Midpoint sum: heights at 0.5, 1.5, 2.5, 3.5, total 9.25, a slight underestimate. Trapezoidal sum: trapezoids under the chords, total 9.5, an overestimate. The true area is 28/3, about 9.33.

text.tspan: + 1 on [0, 4], four subintervals of width 1. True area: 28/3 ≈ 9.33
